notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement (p4) Total column. Insurance Proceeds 80,822, Other Grant income 4,500 and Gain on Sale of Assets 9,600 are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses) and go to other_financing (94,922); General transfers out 138,608 to the Proprietary Fund. Cash: the governmental balance sheet (p3) prints only end-of-year cash lines (Cash and Equivalents 473,811, Restricted Cash 169,139, Due from County Treasurer 5,166) and no beginning cash, so beginning/ending_cash are left null and the fund balance (705,562 -> 648,116) is the roll-forward measure; the cash lines are in balance_sheet. Business-type: Statement of Activities (p2) charges for services 183,517, disbursements 297,108, beginning 68,681, transfers 138,608, ending 93,698; line items from the proprietary budget-and-actual statement (p12): operating disbursements 266,136 + debt service 9,790 + capital outlay - sewer 21,182 = 297,108. Proprietary Statement of Cash Flows p13. Balance sheet: governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p3), whose totals equal the governmental activities column of the Statement of Net Position (p1); business-type line from p1; zero liability lines (Payroll taxes, Deposits) omitted. Detail: General Fund revenue and other financing from p5; General Fund spending from the departmental schedules (pp6-9, more detailed than p5's four function lines, which are not recorded); Debt Service Fund p10; Proprietary Fund p12. The General and Administrative budget column totals 293,644 on p6 vs 292,644 on p5 (budget only; actuals agree). Street Department schedule heading misprints the year as 20236. Read pages 1-13 of 13
